useCases.title: Migrate my n8n automations to Strawberry
useCases.message: Help me figure out which of my n8n automations I can move to Strawberry. Go into my n8n account and look at my active workflows. Tell me which ones Strawberry can handle natively and how you'd rebuild each one.
